entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 34074 of 2023
Applicant :- Ravi Kant

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Dubey,Shambhu Mani Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned AGA for the State.

2. The present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to direct the learned Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra to decide Complaint Case No. 3309 of 2015, under Sections 494,
498A IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Khandouli, District- Agra expeditiously within stipulated period.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is an accused in the instant case and he had filed an application for discharge under Section 245 Cr.P.C. on 4.8.2022, which is still pending disposal and has not yet been decided and has been lingering-on, on one pretext or the other.
Ravi Kant vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146221430/
1 4.

entities.text: Ravi Kant vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, the Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra is expected to make all endeavours to decide the aforesaid discharge application expeditiously, preferably within a period of two months from the date of filing of certified copy of this order after giving opportunity of hearing to both the parties without giving any unnecessary adjournments to either parties and there is no other legal impediment in deciding the aforesaid discharge application.
5.
With the aforesaid observations, the application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 15.9.2023 KU  Ravi Kant vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146221430/
